description: Source code for LM Studio API provider, including class LmStudioHandler for handling chat completions and prompt completions, with utilities for model fetching and error handling.

classes.name: LmStudioHandler
classes.description: Class for handling interactions with LM Studio API, including message creation, model retrieval, and prompt completion.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Generates a streaming chat message response from LM Studio, handling token counting, tool calls, and stream processing.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model information, either from cache or default.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt with LM Studio in a non-streaming manner.
